title: Orbit Board v2.0.0
changelog: 🔴 New App Icon & Monored Theme — Official Orbit Board icon, monochrome icon, splash screen & 4-tone Monored theme
🎨 5-Tab Studio & Live Preview — Real-time preview with EN/Avro/Bornokromik/123 switcher, Material You (Monet), Color Wheel & Hex Keypad
🖼️ Wallpapers, Glass & Float — Custom keyboard background cropper, frosted Glass/Float styles, Atma Bangla font & Laser Flow effect
🧭 Dynamic Action Bar — Pinned menu hides while typing, stays through Space, returns on Enter/Full Stop/empty box + up to 4 pinned actions
⌨️ Latin Swipe Typing & Glide Delete — Fast gesture typing with floating preview and word-by-word swipe delete + Undo
🇧🇩 Better Bengali & Feedback — Expanded Avro/Bornokromik suggestions, Text Shortcuts, Kaomoji, custom key sound packs & colorful 123 keys
